summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. Figure 1A shows 18 TMTpro channels including ovaries/134C and testes/135; Methods '16 channels' text is inconsistent with the figure and 10-tissue design. SDRF correctly follows Figure 1A (72 KEY raws × 18 = 1296 rows).

reviewer_context.context: fresh hook agent without producer transcript

spec_compliance.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates --use_ols_cache_only: warnings only (C57BL/6J free text). Factor organism part only; SAX as sample preparation batch.

ontology_integrity.evidence: UBERON parts for 10 tissues resolve; Orbitrap Eclipse MS:1003029; Lys-C+Trypsin; TMTpro UNIMOD:2016; camC/oxM present. Strain C57BL/6J free-text warning only.

source_evidence.evidence: sandbox/PXD061609/figs/panelA_top.png shows Brain 126/127N … Spleen 133C/134N, Ovaries 134C, Testes 135 (18 channels). nihms.txt Methods says '16 channels' but Results list ten tissues including ovaries/testes with female-then-male pairing — SDRF matches Figure 1A + Results, not the Methods typo.

file_mapping.evidence: KEY.xlsx 72 basenames all present in PRIDE files.json (75 raws); held-out ea12594b/ea12620b/ea12621b absent from KEY as claimed; 72 files × 18 labels = 1296 rows.

design_consistency.evidence: Per-file label→tissue→sex mapping matches Figure 1A (female then male for paired tissues; ovary female 134C; testis male 135). Batches NoSAX/HighSalt/LowSalt × 24 fractions × 18 = 1296. Factor organism part only.

omission_safety.evidence: Age/developmental stage correctly not available; 18-channel choice is figure-supported rather than fabricated; three *b reruns held out without invented mapping.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf exit 0 with strain warning; tools score 100/100.

findings.message: Manuscript Methods say '16 channels' while Figure 1A and tissue list require 18; SDRF correctly prefers the figure.
findings.evidence: nihms.txt line ~223 'all 16 channels'; panelA_top.png labels through 134C and 135.
